label: Idle
use: Waiting for input. Slow breath, a blink, one ear flick.

label: Listening
use: User is typing. Head tilts toward the input, small nods.

label: Thinking
use: Model is reasoning. Looks up, eyes narrow, three cyan beads.

label: Streaming
use: Writing a reply. Bobs on the beat while lines type out.

label: Running tool
use: A tool is executing. Holds a small terminal, watches progress.

label: Waiting for permission
use: Needs a yes or no. Sits up, paw raised, looks at you.

label: Success
use: Task done. Squat, hop, happy eyes, green check.

label: Error
use: Something failed. Ears droop, a small head shake, red badge.

label: Interrupted
use: User pressed stop. Startled hop back, freeze, settle.

label: Memory recalled
use: A stored fact comes back. Cyan bead rises, sinks in, eyes glow.

label: Unloading / sleeping
use: Weights moved to disk. Curled low, eyes shut, slow z.

label: Waking / restore
use: Weights back in memory. Stretches up, double blink, ears pop.

label: Greeting
use: Session start, waking, or a click. Hops, waves a paw, happy eyes.

label: Reading
use: Read tool, or summarizing. Holds a page, eyes scan line by line.

label: Searching
use: Grep or search. Sweeps a magnifier across, eyes follow it.

label: Editing
use: Edit or Write tool. Scribbles on a notepad with a pencil.

label: Building
use: cargo build or check. Hammers a block, sparks fly on each hit.

label: Testing
use: Running tests. Watches a bubbling flask, leans in.

label: Celebrating
use: A task finished after real work. Big jump, both paws up, confetti.

label: Confused
use: Unknown command or an unclear request. Head tilts side to side, question marks.
